summary_1line: Narada recounts how Brahma’s wrath created Death, who reluctantly accepts her role, with disease and human passions causing mortality.

image_candidates.scene_text: From Brahma’s body emerges a dark-red goddess with blazing eyes and ornaments, while Brahma and Shiva watch as cosmic fire fades.
The goddess Death stands on one leg in harsh austerity for ages in a lonely forest hermitage, emaciated yet radiant with resolve.
Brahma holds the weeping goddess’s tears in his hands, declaring they will become diseases that bring death to living beings.
